computeAddress(address,bytes32,bytes32).details: Must be called with the SAME `deployer` (future `msg.sender`) that will call `deploy`, otherwise the prediction does not match. Uses the factory as the CREATE2 deployer, exactly as `deploy` does.

params.bytecodeHash: keccak256 of the creation bytecode passed to `deploy`.

computeNamespacedSalt(address,bytes32).details: Uses abi.encode (not abi.encodePacked) so the (address, bytes32) tuple encoding is unambiguous. Pure so off-chain tooling and scripts can reproduce the exact salt without a node call.

deploy(bytes32,bytes).details: Payable so constructors needing an initial native balance can be funded atomically; the full `msg.value` is forwarded and nothing stays in the factory (no receive/fallback, no withdrawal path needed). Reverts via OpenZeppelin's Create2 library on empty bytecode, on insufficient balance for `msg.value`, or when the address is already taken (same caller + same `userSalt` + same `bytecode` deployed twice).

params.bytecode: Creation bytecode with constructor args already appended.
params.userSalt: Caller-chosen salt; namespaced with `msg.sender` before use.

returns.deployedAddress: Address of the newly deployed contract.

computeAddress(address,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Predicts the address `deploy` would produce for a caller + salt + bytecode.

computeNamespacedSalt(address,bytes32).notice: Namespaces a caller-chosen salt to a specific deployer account.

deploy(bytes32,bytes).notice: Deploys `bytecode` via CREATE2 on behalf of `msg.sender`.
